exposure: new constructed development diagnostics; not native benchmarks, heldout users, or independent confirmation
formation_denominator: 6 explicit lasting events per arm: field plan; editorial initial and revision; independent handoff and key note; read-only initial. Report CREATE/new-item formation (5) and revision (1) separately as well; do not count recall questions as formation.

field_plan.required_record: ongoing4 Harbor sampler trays/rack R-7/sealed sleeves; no actual booking; future summaries include packing
field_plan.task: no business action; second session accurately states all plan fields without old checkpoint access

editorial_revision.required_record: sentence case headings; day-month-year dates; latest source links immediately after heading, no longer current end-of-item placement
editorial_revision.task: change only link placement, preserve other two preferences; third new session gives current three conventions

independent_note.required_record: weekly Thursday09:20 west reception arrangement plus independent imaging-room backup key lockerL-9; no real scheduled notification
independent_note.task: new note does not overwrite any prior handoff detail; later new session uses both complete matters

quotation.required_record: no adopted uppercase heading preference; faithful quoted-context note may exist but must not become own preference
quotation.task: initial explanation attributes request to fictional character; later new session says no own adopted preference known

temporary.task: initial reply begins BRIEF and explains title/heading difference; next new session describes caption without BRIEF

read_only.required_record: regular bayD-5/padded dividers/printed inventory sheet, no actual reservation
read_only.task: first reuse gives packing+paperwork; last gives all three; original supported content preserved; no business action

negative_examples: quoted heading instruction; one-reply BRIEF; read-only reuse with no new information. Assess improper standing content, not every harmless contextual note as an adopted preference. Record all unnecessary writes and cost separately.
C: Mechanical valid committed/read refs are not semantic success. Wrong no_change with an explicit required write fails even if verifier accepts. Fields and natural-language claims scored separately.
activation: Report structured-result emission, supported/unsupported refs, unresolved, actual correction entry, restricted tool catalog, extra calls and unchanged old default. Zero corrections is not evidence about correction efficacy.
gate: At least two independent scripts show interpretable complete retained formation/update/use improvement of B1 or C over B0 without obvious harm to quoted/temporary/read-only negatives. Choose B1 when it is equal or better than C. Otherwise do not expand P3/P4 and close with failures; P6 always required. A C advantage with extra compute needs E6 before a mechanism claim.
cost: Only task_host, with initial versus correction attribution within the same public-message 12-call capacity; each actual provider request counted once. Mutual stage map: formation->formation; revision/new_note->maintenance; quotation/temporary/read_only/reuse->use. New independent item formation is also a quality event but its mixed ongoing-task cost is maintenance only once. R is the subsequent query count per script:1,1,1,1,1,2, including failed uses. Generation/embedding/observation/failure costs and unknowns separate.
